findings.message: The native datetime inputs lose their field container in the read-only state, so they read as static text rather than disabled fields and break the otherwise consistent field rhythm of the form. Proposal: Keep the same disabled container (background, radius, border) for 开始时间/结束时间 as the other fields, and dim only the text and calendar icon.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.state.disabled.png — the 开始时间 and 结束时间 rows (below 项目, y≈285–360): both fields show only placeholder text and a nearly invisible calendar glyph, with no disabled fill or border, while 客户/项目/护理师/来源 keep a visible disabled box.

findings.message: The skeleton covers six days but skips the selected day, so the highlighted column looks already loaded or intentionally empty while the rest still looks pending; the grid reads as a partially loaded or disabled calendar. Proposal: Apply the skeleton treatment to the whole grid including the 周三 column, and indicate selection with an overlay border/accent instead of leaving the column un-skeletonized.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.state.loading.png — calendar grid, selected 周三 column (x≈146–190): the selected day column is solid white while the other six day columns are gray skeleton cells; no block-level skeleton placeholders are drawn.

findings.message: The single grayed day column reads as disabled or out of range even though it is part of the current week; shading only Sunday implies an unstated availability rule and competes with the selected-day highlight. Proposal: Remove the gray tint and lighter label if 11-09 is selectable; if it is a closure, state the reason in the date header or legend and apply an explicit rule instead of shading only one day.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.default.png — rightmost calendar column and header 周日 11-09 (x≈328–374): the column background is gray and the weekday label is lighter than the other six days, while 周六 11-08 is white with dark text.

findings.message: The confirmed timestamp uses a slash-separated, seconds-precision format that differs from the hyphenated YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format elsewhere, breaking date/time consistency across detail pages. Proposal: Render 确认时间 with the shared product date pattern (e.g. 2026-10-22 09:00) and drop the seconds.
findings.evidence: screenshots/treatment-notice.business.已确认.png — summary card, 确认时间 row (y≈250): '2026/10/22 09:00:00'; compare appointment-detail.default.png 创建时间 '2026-11-01 15:20'.
